fusions.name: Plummet
fusions.desc: A stooping strike on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Wingbeat Gust
fusions.desc: Beats a gust 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 wind damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Tailwind Glide
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 6% for 8 seconds, and carries you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Riding the Updraft
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover restores 5 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
